mechanics.name: Locked Book
mechanics.tutorialText: Make 2 merges next to this book. The counter goes down; then a key opens its lock.

mechanics.name: Star Book
mechanics.tutorialText: Put it in its spot to get +3 moves.

mechanics.name: Tied Books
mechanics.tutorialText: They move together. Make a merge beside either book to untie them.

mechanics.name: Hidden Book
mechanics.tutorialText: Make a merge beside this book to uncover its picture.

mechanics.name: Ticking Book
mechanics.tutorialText: Each move counts down. Put it in its spot before 0 or lose 3 moves.

mechanics.name: Key Book
mechanics.tutorialText: Put it in its spot to open every lock at once.

mechanics.name: Double Lock
mechanics.tutorialText: Locks now start with a counter: two nearby merges open them.
